articles.title: Einstein's 'Wormhole' Isn't a Tunnel — It's a Time Mirror!
articles.summary: What if a wormhole isn't a space shortcut but a mirror that flips time? Scientists say Einstein's original idea was never about travel — it's about two arrows of time, forward and backward, that keep the universe from losing information. This could solve a huge black hole mystery.

articles.title: SpaceX's Giant Starship V3 Just Flew to Space for the First Time!
articles.summary: SpaceX launched its biggest, most powerful Starship yet — Version 3 — on its 12th test flight. The 408-foot-tall rocket reached space, but the booster crashed into the Gulf of Mexico instead of landing softly. Even with engine troubles, it deployed 22 Starlink satellites and captured amazing video from orbit.

articles.title: A Hospital Closed. Now a Brother Wonders If His Sister Could Have Been Saved.
articles.summary: When Martin General Hospital in North Carolina shut down in 2023, it left 22,000 people without nearby emergency care. A year later, Stanley Sears had a heart attack and died after a 30-minute ambulance ride. His sister Debra still wonders if a local hospital could have saved him. A $50 billion rural health fund won't help reopen it.
